sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form with their last five results all wins or draws (most recently a win), and face an Alsager side rooted to the bottom with just 4 points from 10 matches and on a run of five consecutive defeats. This should be a comfortable fixture for Sandbach to extend their lead.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second place on 20 points, travel to Dawley Town and will be eager to close the gap on leaders Sandbach. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in what shapes as a mid-table battle, while fourth-ranked Wolverhampton Casuals face Wednesfield Community at home. Bilston Town, fifth on 17 points, welcome Foley Meir in another competitive contest. At the foot of the table, struggling Widnes Town visit Brereton Social, and Telford Town—winless in their last five—travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads in a basement battle. Elsewhere, Crewe entertain Allscott Heath, Shawbury United host Barnton, and Market Drayton Town face New Mills. Telford, Widnes, Cheadle Heath Nomads, and Alsager are all fighting relegation form, while New Mills (on 14 points) and Wednesfield Community (13 points) aim to climb away from the lower reaches.
